answer: To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 6 epochs old, anchored at a lotus checkpoint. The nebula chain is verified at intake and anchor publishes each anchor. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 6 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. That bill is paid per identity, so 298 aliases cost 80 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
